Maya (Growth): Quick check — we want to try a small 'swatch' experiment for plan wording + calculator placement. Hypothesis: clearer microcopy + calculator above the fold reduces demo requests but increases self-serve signups.
Ryan (PM): Nice. Timeline?
Maya (Growth): Run for 2 weeks, target US + EU traffic split 60/40, track signups, demo clicks, and CS leads. :bar_chart: 
Sophia (Design): I sketched two hero variants: Variant A keeps calculator in hero, Variant B moves calculator into an inline overlay. Also three wording swatches for tier labels.
Olivia (Content): Wording swatches: "Starter / Business / Scale", "Build / Grow / Enterprise", and a functional set "Prototype / Production / Dedicated". My pick is swatch C for clarity.
Neal (Sales): Important — ensure 'Dedicated' isn't conflated with Dedicated product (reserved capacity). Maybe suffix with '(Dedicated capacity)'.
Maya (Growth): Good call. Let's add note to variants to disambiguate. Neal, can sales team flag any wording that will generate SLA questions? 
Neal (Sales): I'll create a short doc of likely FAQs — will DM.
Jules (Eng): Question: the calculator is the small JS widget — is moving it into overlay a separate bundle? Might need a quick lift. ETA ~2 days to implement both placements.
Sophia (Design): I can hand off assets by EOD.
Maya (Growth): Experiment config: 
```
experiment: package_wording_swatch_v1
variants: A(hero_calc + swatchA), B(overlay_calc + swatchB), C(hero_calc + swatchC_clarified)
traffic: 33/33/34
metrics: signup.rate, demo_click.rate, cs_ticket.count
duration_days: 14
``` 
Jules (Eng): OK I'll wire up the flags. Will we want a canary region? 
Maya (Growth): Start globally but opt-out EU legal for first 48 hours to verify privacy copy. legal-bot: Reminder: EU GDPR = must show data residency + contact. Add modal link to privacy page. 
legal-bot: Approved: add short line under pricing table "Data stored in EU on request — contact support".
Ryan (PM): Analytics: Slice by org_size, new vs returning, and region. Also add a funnel event for "calculator_submit" and "calculator_view"
Olivia (Content): I'll update FAQ entries for the new labels and add microcopy for 'Dedicated (reserved capacity)'.
Maya (Growth): Perfect. Jules — ping when flags live and we have experiment ID. Also please ensure the client-side event names match Ryan's spec.
Jules (Eng): Will do. Deploy-bot: experiment flag package_wording_swatch_v1 created (id=exp_4582) — ready for rollout.
Maya (Growth): Thanks — launching tomorrow 9am PT. Post-launch checklist: monitor demo leads, watch CS spike, and quick QA pass for EU modal.
Neal (Sales): I'll prep a one-pager for AE's with expected signal changes and talk tracks.
Olivia (Content): I'll queue a quick release note for customers explaining minor label tweaks.
Maya (Growth): Great team — we'll reconvene day 4 for an early signal review. :calendar:
